description: Approve a qualified lead so its DM is queued for sending. This is the human-in-the-loop approval step. Optionally override the AI-drafted message with your own final_message. Approving does not send immediately: the OpenTweet scheduler drips approved DMs out within the campaign's active hours under daily and per-account rate limits, and honors opt-outs and suppression. Keep messages plain and personal, with no links or em dashes.

final_message.description: Optional final DM text to send instead of the AI draft. No links, no em dashes; keep under 280 characters for reliable delivery.

lead_id.description: The lead ID to approve (from dm_leads_list).

name: dm_lead_approve
